price.consumer_warning: Must be treated as stale unless fetched_at is current for the intended decision date.

pe.basis: provider valuation multiple; NOT guaranteed to be TTM, forecast, or annual-report PE
pe.consumer_warning: Do not label this as TTM PE or use it as a registration-grade valuation anchor without primary/financial reconciliation.

change_pct.basis: same-day percentage change in the fetched quote snapshot

pe_ttm_clean.basis: computed TTM PE = market_cap / trailing-12m net income attr. parent

roe_ttm.basis: computed ROE-TTM = trailing-12m net income / average equity (percent)

ocf_to_ni.basis: trailing-12m operating cash flow / trailing-12m net income (earnings quality)

value.basis: cross-sectional rank of low PE (computed TTM PE preferred per name, else provider) and low PB
value.consumer_warning: PE now prefers computed TTM PE where available; PB still provider.

quality.basis: cross-sectional rank of ROE-TTM (trailing-12m net income / average equity)
quality.consumer_warning: Real ROE-TTM; loss-makers rank low, names without a full TTM window are neutral-filled.

momentum.basis: 12-1 month HFQ-adjusted return (T-252→T-21 trading days), cross-sectional rank
momentum.consumer_warning: Real 12-1 month momentum. Names without a full 12-month price window are neutral-filled, not penalised.

size.basis: distance from 60th percentile log market-cap sweet spot

low_vol.basis: cross-sectional rank of lower same-day amplitude

_meta.research_use_warning: universe_* factors are screening hints only. Registration-grade thesis work must reconcile price, valuation, and financials against primary/committed evidence.

cyclical_normalization.consumer_warning: stocks[].cyclical_flag marks commodity/cyclical names whose TTM profitability is above their own 5y median (peak-cycle value-trap shape); a deep thesis on a flagged name must build a NORMALIZED earnings bridge, not extrapolate peak TTM.
